search_results.title: Harbor Logistics – Freight forwarding and cold-chain
search_results.content: Harbor Logistics is a mid-size freight logistics company with about 180 employees and offices in Rotterdam and Singapore.

search_results.title: Harbor Logistics launches cold-chain service
search_results.content: This year Harbor Logistics launched a new cold-chain service for pharmaceutical shipments.

harborlogistics.example.page_text: Harbor Logistics. Freight forwarding, warehousing and cold-chain logistics. Offices in Rotterdam and Singapore. About 180 people.
